title: Glitched Syllables
description: A metallic FM vocal-chirp pluck that stutters out glitched syllables: short triangle plucks with a stepped FM index ratchet through euclid and ply patterns, while a pitch envelope snaps each chirp upward and a formant vowel sweep gives it a talking, alien-syllable character. The arc morphs over 32 cycles as the FM index, vowel, euclid density and filter all walk on offset clocks, then resolves into a clicky delay trail.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 eb4 g4 bb4 f4 g4 ab4 eb4>*4").s("triangle")
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.13).sustain(0).release(0.02)
    .fm("<3 7 11 5 9 4 13 6>/8").fmh("<1 1.5 0.5 2>/4")
    .ply("<1 2 1 3 1 2 4 2>/2")
    .euclid("<5 7 9 11 7 5 13 9>", 16)
    .penv("<12 18 7 24 9 15 5 20>/4").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.05)
    .vowel("<a e i o u e i a>/3")
    .lpf(sine.range(900, 5200).slow(23)).resonance(saw.range(6, 16).slow(13)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(perlin.range(2, 7).slow(11)).lpattack(0.002).lpdecay(0.06)
    .crush(perlin.range(7, 14).slow(29))
    .shape(0.3)
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .pan(saw.range(0.1, 0.9).slow(7))
    .delay("0.45:0.1875:0.62").delayfeedback(0.55).orbit(2)
    .gain(0.92)
)
